minutes.headline: PACC voted to ask the special town meeting to transfer over $35,000 from the enterprise fund to cover a shortfall
minutes.summary: The committee voted on wording for a special town meeting warrant article to transfer money from the PEG enterprise fund/retained earnings to cover FY26 budget items that couldn't be encumbered earlier, plus added videographer expenses. The station manager also presented a first-pass FY27 budget showing a large projected shortfall, gave hiring and studio-move updates, and the committee spent most of the meeting working through a Master Plan Steering Committee questionnaire, agreeing to hold an extra meeting to finish it.

votes.motion: To combine the borrowed FY26 amount and additional videographer expenses into one special town meeting warrant article to transfer money from the PEG enterprise fund/retained earnings

budget_items.topic: Money borrowed against FY26 budget pending retained earnings approval
budget_items.what_was_said: The committee had spent money during the town meeting budget process that could not yet be formally encumbered because retained earnings/the enterprise fund hadn't been certified, and it now needs to be restored via a special town meeting warrant.
The committee is covering more meetings than originally planned when the town meeting budget was assembled, requiring additional funds beyond what was budgeted.

budget_items.topic: Combined special town meeting warrant total
budget_items.what_was_said: The committee combined the borrowed amount and the additional coverage expenses into a single figure to put into the special town meeting warrant.

budget_items.topic: FY27 first-pass budget: revenue, expenses, and shortfall
budget_items.what_was_said: The station manager completed an early FY27 budget draft per the town manager's directive, showing expenses (driven largely by salaries) rising sharply against flat revenue, leaving a projected shortfall that would require drawing on retained earnings or other resources.

budget_items.topic: Capital replacement of Casters system for FY27
budget_items.what_was_said: A member raised whether the aging Casters system should be budgeted for replacement in FY27, noting existing capital funds, and asked the manager to get a price that would also support an additional HD channel.

budget_items.topic: FY[year] starting and ending fund balances
budget_items.what_was_said: The manager reported the closed-out balance figures for the prior fiscal year, referencing the attached town financial report for members to check against.
The committee noted it is currently at the maximum franchise fee allowed, having previously been at a lower rate for a long time, tied to past work justifying the fee via a business plan.
The manager said no new investment status report was available this cycle, as it is only received quarterly and the last one covered end of June.

transfers.description: Transfer from PEG enterprise fund/retained earnings to restore the general fund for FY26 borrowed amount plus additional operating expenses
transfers.outcome: voted (as warrant language for the special town meeting; final transfer subject to town meeting vote)

decisions.decision: Manager to obtain a price for replacing the Casters system in FY27, checking whether it can also support an additional HD channel.
Chair confirmed to the town manager that he will serve as PACC's representative on the Master Plan Steering Committee, as previously voted by the board.

Chair and manager will search their own notes and records for existing PACC policies (drone use, private equipment use, equal-time/open meeting related) ahead of the next meeting, rather than contacting a former member.

Committee agreed to schedule an additional meeting to continue working through the Master Plan Steering Committee questionnaire, tentatively the following Monday, location depending on the studio move and library/Pacios availability.
The scheduled special meeting will include only a roll call, the master plan item, and a motion to adjourn.

what_happened.line: PACC voted to combine a repayment for FY26 items that could not be encumbered earlier with added videographer costs into one special town meeting warrant article.
That article would transfer money out of the PEG cable enterprise fund's retained earnings.
The station manager's first-pass FY27 budget showed expenses, driven mainly by salaries, rising against flat revenue, projecting a shortfall.
A member asked the manager to price replacing the aging Casters recording system for FY27 and check if it could also support an added HD channel.
The committee could not finish a Master Plan Steering Committee questionnaire and set an added meeting limited to that item.

why_it_matters: Residents will be asked at a special town meeting to approve a transfer from the cable enterprise fund's retained earnings, drawing down a reserve rather than raising taxes.
A projected FY27 shortfall, driven largely by salaries against flat revenue, could mean a larger draw on that same reserve or other funding in next year's cable budget.
A possible capital request to replace aging recording equipment could surface in FY27 capital planning.
